top.line: A Kickstarter plan: a sovereign website on a configured Android tablet or Raspberry Pis, three tiers.

in-short.line: An appliance on Kickstarter, Android first, three tiers, backer's choice, the UK first, launch alone.

product.line: A tablet configured with the site, editing, monitoring, an AI app and a vault backup, or Raspberry Pis.

android.line: Android is open and fully ours; the Web Summit tablet is the prototype; iOS a stretch goal.

tiers.line: £50 supporter; £500 with about £250 of hardware; £1,000 with about £500; add-ons.

hardware.line: Lenovo Idea Tab £209.99, Galaxy Tab S10 FE £509, the Volla Tablet with /e/OS, Pi 5 kits from £99.70.

pi.line: Pis as hosts alongside GitHub Pages, reached without proprietary tunnels where possible.

goals.line: The UK as the base goal, Portugal first, then countries by vote, and iOS; all-or-nothing.

value.line: Every backer sees their own site in a vault before anything ships.

partners.line: Launch with Android and open source, then talk to device makers as a funded project.

after.line: Late pledges, pre-orders on sovereignwebsite.ai, and Patreon later.

limits.line: Nothing submitted; prices are examples; the device software is a plan; no goal amount yet.

sources.line: The afternoon's record and UK retailers' pages on 19 November.
